_about: Rules, regulations and notifications made under the Companies Act, 2017, with the sections they carry out. `library` names the instrument's id when its text is in the library; `sections` lists the Act's sections; `basis` says where the link comes from; `confirm` lists what still has to be checked against the instrument itself. Sections cited by instruments in the library are found automatically and need not be listed here.

instruments.title: Companies Regulations, 2024
instruments.latest: Amended by S.R.O. 1355(I)/2025 of 25 July 2025 (SECP lists it as “SRO 1356”)
instruments.basis: Made under section 512(1) (recital to the regulations). The sections each regulation cites are linked automatically.

instruments.title: Listed Companies (Buy-back of Shares) Regulations, 2019
instruments.basis: Section 88(1) lets a company buy back its shares “subject to … the regulations specified in this behalf”. Unlisted companies are covered by the Companies Regulations, 2024.
confirm: latest amended edition on SECP's Regulations page

instruments.title: Companies (Related Party Transactions and Maintenance of Related Records) Regulations, 2018
instruments.basis: Section 208 subjects related party transactions to “such conditions as may be specified”.

instruments.title: Companies (Distribution of Dividends) Regulations, 2017
